Uthuk Y'llan Army Expansion, Flesh Rippers Unit Expansion

rules.name: Berserkers - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may suffer 1 wound to gain Lethal 1 for this Melee Attack. Limit twice per Melee Attack.

rules.name: Flesh Rippers - Melee Surge+ Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy engaged with you. It suffers damage equal to the Surge spent.

rules.name: Flesh Rippers - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before you reveal your command tool, you must perform a speed-1 Shift.

rules.name: Spined Threshers - Melee Ability
rules.description: If the defender has a panic token, you may reroll 1 die.

rules.name: Spined Threshers - Passive Ability
rules.description: After your activation, each enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] without a panic token receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Ravos the Everhungry - Melee Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: Each enemy at range 1 suffers 1 would.

rules.name: Ravos the Everhungry - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before each End Phase, you must choose a unit at range 1. It suffers 1 wound.

rules.name: Ynfernael Presence
rules.description: After setup, each enemy receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Obscenes - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy engaged with you that has no more than three times your number of trays. That enemy performs a speed-1 Shift in a direction of your choice. This Shift cannot be used to enter or exit terrain.

rules.name: Viper Legion Archers - Ranged Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surge: Gain Lethal 1 for this Ranged Attack.

rules.name: Viper Legion Archers - Ranged Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Unique Surge: If there are at least 2 [Unstable Rune], the defender receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Viper Legion Archers - Ranged Ability
rules.description: If the defender has a bane, the number of Surge that precedes your Surge abilities is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1. This does not affect Surge+ abilities.

rules.name: Kethra A'laak - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: Surge: The defender suffers 2 damage.

rules.name: Kethra A'laak - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an ally and roll 1 white die. That ally and each enemy at range 1-2 of that ally suffers wounds equal to the hit results.

rules.name: Twisted Bone
rules.description:
After deployment, choose up to 2 allies. Those allies receive the "Unnatural Growths" condition.

Unnatural Growths: After defending against a Melee Attack, the attacker suffers 2 damage.

rules.name: Th'Uk Tar and Gorgemaw - Melee Ability
rules.description: Your front edge is treated as touching the front edge of all enemies at range 1 and in your front firing arc that you are not engaged with.

rules.name: Th'Uk Tar and Gorgemaw - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a March you may increase its speed by 1. When you perform a Shift, you may treat it as modified by Turn.

rules.name: The Slavering Horde
rules.description: After setup, each ally at range 1-5 of Th'Uk Tar and Gorgemaw may suffer 1 wound to receive 1 inspiration token.

rules.name: Beastmaster Th'Uk Tar - Melee Ability
rules.description: Your front edge is treated as touching the front edge of all enemies at range 1 and in your front firing arc that you are not engaged with.

rules.name: Beastmaster Th'Uk Tar - Skill ability
rules.description: You may choose a non-unique ally at range 1-2. It suffers 1 wound, then performs either a Reform or speed-1 Shift.

rules.name: Called to Heel
rules.description: After deployment, you may remove 1 allied non-unique unit from the play area then redeploy that unit at range 1 of beastmaster Th'Uk Tar and within your deployment area.

rules.name: Bannerscamp - Passive Ability
rules.description:
When an enemy at range 1-5 would suffer a morale test, you may instead cause it to receive panic tokens equal to the severity of that test. Limit once per round.

After an enemy at range 1-5 performs a Rally, it receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Rage Spine - Passive Ability
rules.description: After an enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] suffers the effects of a morale card with 1 morale symbol, you may also suffer the effects of that card. If you do, that enemy suffers the effects of that card again.

rules.name: Warsprinter - Passive Ability
rules.description:
While your command tool is revealed, allies gain:

Skill : Perform a speed-1 March.

You also gain:

Skill : Perform a speed-[Unstable Rune] March.

rules.name: Bloodrage Conduit - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may exhaust any number of your "Bloodrage Conduits" to gain Lethal 1 during this Melee Attack for each card exhausted this way.

rules.name: Bloodrage Conduit - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before you are destroyed, you may ready 1 "Bloodrage Conduit" in your army, even if this card is exhausted.

rules.name: Viscera Goblet - Passive Ability
rules.description:
After setup, place 1 wound token on this card.

After your activation, you may discard 1 wound token from this card to remove 1 wound.

When an enemy at range 1 is destroyed, place 1 wound token on this card.

rules.name: Fearmonger's Whip - Melee Ability
rules.description: Gain Lethal X, where X is equal to the number of panic tokens on the defender.

rules.name: Dragonjaw Focus - Skill Ability
rules.description:
Choose an enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune]. Draw 1 morale card. You may have the enemy suffer the effects of that card. If you do, then you suffer the effects of that card. 

After you resolve this Skill, you may resolve another of your Skill abilities.

rules.name: Ravos the Everhungry - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Before each End Phase, you must choose a unit at range 1. It suffers 1 wound.

After setup, each enemy receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Blood Diviner - Passive Ability
rules.description:
At the start of each round, look at the top [Stable Rune] cards of your morale deck. You may exhaust this card to discard 1 of those cards.

When a unit at range 1-3 loses 1 or more figures, if this card is exhausted, you may ready it.

rules.name: Bloodfire Witch - Passive Ability
rules.description:
After energy tokens are cast during setup and the End Phase, you may either:
-Exhaust this card to recast 1 energy token. 
-Suffer 1 wound to recast 1 energy token with inactive [Unstable Rune] runes, even if this card is exhausted.

modifiers.value: X is the number of moral symbols on the revealed moral card.

rules.name: Cacophony Reaver - Passive Ability
rules.description: Play with the top card of your morale deck revealed.

rules.name: Grotesque Slasher - Melee Ability
rules.description:
After this Melee Attack, you may exhaust this upgrade to roll 1 blue die.
-If you roll a Hit, the defender receives 1 stun token. 
-If you roll a Surge, the defender receives 1 immobilize token. 

Then, this figure may suffer 1 wound to ready this card.

rules.name: Mutilated Grotesque - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description: You may exhaust this card to add Morale.

rules.name: Mutilated Grotesque - Passive Ability
rules.description: When an enemy engaged with you suffers a morale test, draw 1 additional morale card, even if this card is exhausted.

rules.name: Psychosis Siren - Skill Ability
rules.description: You may exhaust this card to cause each enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] to suffer a severity-1 morale test.

rules.name: Psychosis Siren - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune], even if this card is exhausted. That enemy receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Kethra A'laak (Cavalry Upgrade) - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Kethra A'laak (Cavalry Upgrade) - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an ally and roll 1 white die. That ally and each enemy at range 1-2 of that ally suffer wounds equal to the number of Hit results.

rules.name: Kethra A'laak (Infantry Upgrade) - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Kethra A'laak (Infantry Upgrade) - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an ally and roll 1 white die. That ally and each enemy at range 1-2 of that ally suffer wounds equal to the number of Hit results.

rules.name: Beastmaster Th'Uk Tar
rules.description:
Before you reveal your command tool, this unit may suffer 1 wound, then perform a speed-1 Shift or a Reform.

This unit does not receive panic tokens when it performs a March or Shift and collides with an enemy.

rules.name: Th'Uk Tar and Gorgemaw (Siege Upgrade) - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may add 1 red die.

rules.name: Th'Uk Tar and Gorgemaw (Siege Upgrade) - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Before you reveal your command tool,  this unit may suffer 1 wound, then perform a speed-1 Shift or a Reform.

This unit does not receive panic tokens when it performs a march or shift and collides with an enemy.

rules.name: Viper Trapmaster - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Before deployment, choose 1 terrain and place 1 bane of your choice on it.

After the Command Phase, you may discard this card to remove that bane and cause 1 enemy at range 1-2 of that terrain to receive that bane.

rules.name: Ritual Venom - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before your activation, you may suffer up to [Natural Rune] wounds to place an equal number of bane tokens of 1 type of your choice on this card. Limit once per game.

rules.name: Ritual Venom - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description: You may remove 1 bane token from this card. Then the defender receives that bane token.

rules.name: Serrated Spines - Melee Ability
rules.description: Gain Lethal [Stable Runes] for this Melee Attack

rules.name: Frontline Spined Thresher - Melee Ability
rules.description: If the defender has a panic token, you may reroll 1 die.

rules.name: Support Spined Thresher - Passive Ability
rules.description: After your activation, each enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] without a panic token receives 1 panic token.

rules.name: Support Obscene - Passive Ability
rules.description: You must deploy this figure to your back rank.

rules.name: Support Obscene - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy engaged with you that has fewer trays than you. That enemy performs a speed-1 Shift in a direction of your choice. This Shift cannot be used to enter or exit terrin.

rules.name: Front Line Obscene - Melee Ability
rules.description: Unique Surge: If you have at least 1 wound token or 1 empty slot in your trays, the defender receives 1 blight token.

rules.name: Aggressive Shrieker - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a March, treat it as modified by Charge. You do not receive panic tokens for failing to collide with an enemy during a charge.

rules.name: Rallying Shrieker - Skill Ability
rules.description: Each other ally at range 1-3 may choose to either remove 1 bane or ready 1 upgrade card.

rules.name: Tactical Shrieker - Passive Ability
rules.description: You do not receive panic tokens for disengaging from enemies.

rules.name: Aim of the Serpent - Ranged Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: Discard 1 bane token from the defender. That unit receives 1 other bane of your choice.

rules.name: Fear Incarnate - Passive Ability
rules.description: After an enemy at range 1-5 suffers a morale test, it suffers damage equal to the number of moral symbols on the chosen card.

rules.name: Insatiable Hunger - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before each End Phase, you may perform a speed-1 or -2 March. You may treat this March as modified by Turn.

rules.name: Bestial Ferocity - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before you reveal your command tool, you may perform a speed-1 Shift. This Shift cannot be used to exit terrain.

rules.name: Cunning Strikes - Melee Ability
rules.description: If you are not engaged with the defender and are not in the defender's line of sight, you may exhaust this card to treat your front edge as touching the defender's back edge for this attack.

rules.name: Bonecaster - Passive Ability
rules.description: You may perform your Melee Attack as a Ranged Attack.

rules.name: Driven Fury - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you resolve a Skill to cause an ally to perform a speed-1 Shift, that unit may treat that Shift as modified by Charge. Then that ally receives 1 stun token.

rules.name: Tyrant's Lash - Melee Ability
rules.description: Your front edge is also treated as touching the front edge of all enemies at range 1 and in your side firing arcs that you are not engaged with.

rules.name: Tyrant's Lash - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an ally at range 1-2. That ally suffers 1 wound, then discards all of its banes.

rules.name: Cruel Master - Skill Ability
rules.description: You may choose another non-unique ally at range 1-2. It suffers 1 wound, then performs either a Reform or speed-1 Shift.

rules.name: Crushing Jaws - Melee Ability
rules.description: If this is the second Melee Attack you perform during your activation, gain "Unique Surge: Brutal 1" for this attack.

rules.name: Grasping Coils - Passive Ability
rules.description: Units engaged with you cannot perform Reform or Shift during their activation.

rules.name: Lunging Terror - Passive Ability
rules.description: Impact [Stable Runes] (When you collide with an enemy unit during a charge, that unit receives [Stable Rune] panic tokens.)

rules.name: Thrashing Tail - Passive Ability
rules.description: After you perform a Reform, you may exhaust this card to cause each enemy at range 1 to suffer 2 damage.

rules.name: Whirling Sinew - Passive Ability
rules.description: After you perform a Melee Attack while you are not engaged, you may perform a Reform.

rules.name: Kingsbone Armor - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Your defense is increased by 1.

When you collide with an enemy or an enemy collides with you, that enemy suffers 2 damage.

When an enemy engaged with you activates, it suffers 2 damage.

rules.name: Feeding Frenzy - Passive Ability
rules.description:
When an enemy engaged with you loses 1 or more trays, for each tray lost, place 1 wound token on this card.

For every 3 wound tokens on this card, you gain Lethal 1.

rules.name: Dead Sprint
rules.description: During your activation, you may increase the speed of your first March by 1 or treat it as modified by Turn.

rules.name: Devouring Maws - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may remove 1 wound.

rules.name: Scuttling Horror - Passive Ability
rules.description: After each Command Phase, you may perform a speed-1 Shift sideways, even if this card is exhausted.

rules.name: Scuttling Horror - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may exhaust this card to cause the defender to receive 1 stun token.

rules.name: Ynfernael Blood - Passive Ability
rules.description: Blight tokens cannot be spent to remove 1 die from this unit's attack. Instead, after rerolls, a blight token can be spent to reroll all of this unit's attack dice.

rules.name: Odious Appetite - Passive Ability
rules.description: After another unit at range 1 suffers a wound, you may exhaust this card to discard 1 wound token.
